text_block_list.text:
The first three years of the Twinkle 
Series with Marvelous Sunday have come to 
a close—

Her "Global Marvelous Plan" has yielded 
decent results, and more and more these 
days, you can hear "Marvelous!" randomly 
echoing around town.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Woman
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, hey! Did anything "marvelous" happen 
today?

text_block_list.name: Sub-Marvelous Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you really love that word 
"Marvelous," don't you? You say it every 
time we meet!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Woman
text_block_list.text:
Because when you understand "Marvelous", 
the whole world changes!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Woman
text_block_list.text:
Even my usual work becomes fun, and just 
meeting up with friends like this makes me 
so happy!☆

text_block_list.name: Sub-Marvelous Woman
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, thanks! Though when you ask 
what was "marvelous" today—

text_block_list.name: Sub-Marvelous Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I haven't been caught by a 
single red light all morning!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~ that's totally incredible!! That 
must mean—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouu逐步s☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Your lucky thing☆ Is of course Marvelous★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, won't stop☆ Can't stop★ 
If we keep this up, we should be able to 
go much, much farther than usual, right?☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Take good care of your Marvelous, okay?☆ 
Farewell★ Goodbye☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha, ahahahahahaaa☆★

text_block_list.name: Sub-Marvelous Woman
text_block_list.text: ………………Wait, was that real just now?

Today, I was meeting up with Marvelous 
Sunday's grandmother, whom she deeply 
respects—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Grandmaaaa☆ Long time no see★ 
Marvelouuus☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I'm late☆ I spotted a fabulous 
Marvelous in town, so I just had to chase 
after it★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you've become quite the celebrity, 
yet you haven't changed a bit in that 
regard. —Have you been keeping well?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Of course☆ I'm always marvelous★☆ And with 
Grandma doing well, I'm even more 
marvelous★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! I've got so much to tell 
you today☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because I ran a whole bunch in the Twinkle 
Series☆ and found so many Marvelous 
things!★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, of course. Please tell me 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Whoooops☆ But, but, before that★ I spot 
flowers over there that Grandma would 
love☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I'm off to scout them out—☆

Marvelous Sunday dashes off in a flash, 
watched over by her smiling grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're always so full of energy. 
Hey, Trainer? I just wanted to say thank 
you.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for raising her just as she 
is."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"She was always so frail, you know? And 
yet, she started saying she wanted to run 
in races, just like me and her mother—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I was terribly worried. Even 
while telling you things like, 'I believe 
in your Marvelous.'

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Yet after meeting you, Trainer, she was 
able to grow strong and resilient without 
losing an ounce of her wonderful natural 
charm.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Now, she's achieving far greater things 
than I ever did back in the day. —Hehe, am 
I being too much of a doting grandmother?
choice_data_list:
She's going to accomplish even more from 
here on out!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, surely. And that is how we will 
spread "Marvelous" to the whole world.

Her gentle smile as she spoke radiated a 
profound sense of pride in Marvelous 
Sunday.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Trainer!! Grandmaaa!! What're you 
two talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Over here! There's a suuuuper marvelous 
flower blooming☆ So both of you come on! 
Hurry, hurry★☆

And so began another race-filled routine 
with the ever-innocent Marvelous Sunday.

Watched over by a loving family, her 
journey to spread the Marvelous continued—
